design.decision: Bid one or two tricks higher on a hand that is visibly stronger before bids, and lean on newly promoted honors.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; opponents face slightly higher cards everywhere and should expect a larger contract.
design.rationale: Same signature as seed-raise with a smaller amount; seed-raise is the strongest measured enabler (+12.4 at rare), and one rank is the natural common tier of a plainly good, build-agnostic hand improvement.
design.draftText: Opening: Raise every card your team holds by one rank

history.note: draft-common: merged into ca-raise-one, an identical design from another cluster.
